app.title: FieldShift AI
app.subtitle: Smarter crop decisions powered by NASA Earth data.

location.heading: Start with your farm
location.description: Choose a country for context, then enter the coordinates used for environmental analysis.
location.cardDescription: Works anywhere supported data and crop references are available.
location.mapNote: Map selection is planned for a future update. Scientific requests use your coordinates.

farm.heading: Tell us about your farm
farm.description: Share only the details you know. Missing information stays clearly marked as unknown.
farm.conditionsDescription: Help us understand the soil information you have available.
farm.sourceType: How was this soil information recorded?
farm.cropsDescription: Choose supported crops to explore. This small MVP library can grow with sourced profiles.
farm.prioritiesDescription: These priorities describe what matters most to you. They do not change the underlying scientific assessment.
farm.priorityNote: Preference evidence is unavailable for scenario ordering, so options are not ranked by these controls.

analysis.description: We bring together the available environmental context, your farm inputs, and supported crop records.
analysis.sourceNote: Uses NASA Earth observation data where available. NASA POWER and SMAP source details, units, provenance, and limitations are shown in the evidence view after analysis.

results.heading: Your farm context
results.description: Simple highlights first. Open the evidence view whenever you want the supporting details.
results.weatherDescription: NASA Earth data provides local weather context.
results.soilDescription: Your farm details are kept separate from observations.
results.waterDescription: Water context is shown with its source and limitations.
results.rotationAvailable: Available scenarios use supported crops and sourced rotation context. No option is labelled as the best.
results.rotationEmpty: Run an analysis to see available rotation options.
results.whyEmpty: Results remain unknown until the available evidence is analyzed.

explanations.suitable: Crop conditions are suitable within the documented evaluated evidence.
explanations.limiting: Crop conditions have a documented limiting factor. Review the evidence and local input.
explanations.unknown: Crop conditions are unknown because required evidence, a crop calendar, or a sourced requirement is unavailable.

resultDetails.waterEmpty: No SMAP water evidence was returned.
resultDetails.waterLimitation: SMAP is a 9 km model/data-assimilation estimate, not a field measurement.

evidence.heading: Evidence and sources
evidence.missingCalendar: Missing crop calendar can leave climate suitability UNKNOWN.
evidence.smap: SMAP is a 9 km model/data-assimilation context product.
evidence.smapQuality: Model/data-assimilation product, not an in-field sensor.
evidence.preference: PREFERENCE_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE: preferences do not reorder scenarios.
evidence.compatibility: Crop-pair compatibility evidence is not evaluated.

errors.cropLibrary: The crop library is unavailable right now.
errors.chooseCrop: Choose at least one supported crop before starting analysis.
errors.analysis: No analysis services responded. Please check the location and try again.
errors.powerUnavailable: NASA POWER is unavailable; weather context was not loaded.
errors.smapUnavailable: SMAP is unavailable; water context was not loaded.
errors.suitabilityUnavailable: Suitability evidence could not be evaluated.
errors.rotationUnavailable: Rotation options could not be generated.

locationUX.heading: Where is your farm?
locationUX.privacy: Your location is used only to resolve your farm area and analyze environmental conditions for this session.
locationUX.placePlaceholder: Search for a city, region, or place
locationUX.manualNote: Manual coordinates override a searched or detected location for scientific analysis.
locationUX.permissionDenied: Location permission was denied. Search for a place or enter coordinates manually.
locationUX.unavailable: GPS is unavailable on this device.
locationUX.timeout: Location request timed out. Please try again or search for a place.
locationUX.searchUnavailable: Location search is unavailable right now.
locationUX.notFound: Place not found. Try another search.
locationUX.invalid: Invalid coordinates. Enter latitude from -90 to 90 and longitude from -180 to 180.
locationUX.attribution: Place search data © OpenStreetMap contributors, via Nominatim.

preferenceComparison.heading: More aligned with your stated priorities
preferenceComparison.note: These priorities only foreground available evidence. They do not change the scientific assessment or rank scenarios.
preferenceComparison.soilAvailable: Soil Health: qualitative rotation evidence is shown.
preferenceComparison.soilNotForegrounded: Soil Health: evidence is available when you select this priority.
preferenceComparison.resilienceAvailable: Resilience: qualitative rotation-diversity evidence is shown.
preferenceComparison.resilienceNotForegrounded: Resilience: evidence is available when you select this priority.
preferenceComparison.waterUnavailable: Water Conservation: evidence not yet sufficient for comparison.
preferenceComparison.productivityUnavailable: Productivity: evidence not yet sufficient for comparison.

farmerResults.summaryText: Here is what the available environmental, soil, crop, and rotation evidence can tell you.
farmerResults.summaryNote: Unknown information is shown clearly and is not treated as a negative result.

weather.title: Weather
weather.known: NASA weather context is available as {{status}}.
weather.unavailable: Weather context could not be retrieved. You can retry when NASA data are available.
weather.note: These observations provide environmental context and are not an on-farm weather-station measurement.

soil.title: Soil
soil.action: Add soil information to improve this assessment.

water.title: Water
water.known: NASA SMAP water context is available as {{status}}.
water.unavailable: Water context could not be retrieved. Retry when NASA data are available.
water.note: NASA SMAP provides satellite/model soil-moisture context and is not an in-field sensor measurement.

suitability.title: Crop suitability
suitability.intro: Each factor is shown separately; no overall crop-success score is produced.

factor.evaluated: Evaluated against the documented crop record.

rotation.title: Rotation options
rotation.empty: Rotation options are not available yet.
rotation.legume: A sourced chickpea legume descriptor is present.
rotation.aligned: More aligned with your selected priorities: {{dimensions}}.

actions.title: What can I do next?
actions.ph: Add a soil pH measurement to improve crop suitability analysis.
actions.texture: Add your soil texture if known.
actions.calendar: Local planting dates are not yet available for this crop and location.
actions.water: Water context could not be retrieved. Retry when NASA data are available.
actions.none: The available evidence has been shown above; review the limitations before making a decision.

preferences.title: Your priorities
preferences.supported: Soil Health and Resilience can foreground qualitative rotation evidence.
preferences.unavailable: Water Conservation and Productivity do not yet have sufficient evidence for comparison.
